title: getIdealBPT() can serve as manipulation oracle for minBPT calculation
description: getIdealBPT() is an unrestricted non-view function that queries the Balancer router for expected BPT output based on current sUSDS balance. If an authorized pooler or off-chain system uses this value to set minBPT for pool() in the same transaction or block, an attacker can manipulate the Balancer pool state (via flash loan swap) before the query, causing a deflated BPT estimate that neutralizes slippage protection.
impact: If minBPT is derived from getIdealBPT() in manipulated state, slippage protection is defeated.
recommendation: Document that getIdealBPT() must NOT be used as the minBPT source in the same transaction as pool(). Authorized poolers should compute minBPT off-chain using TWAP or other manipulation-resistant methods.
